summary: A 28-year-old female presents with a 3-day history of sore throat, fever, and headache. Physical examination confirms bacterial tonsillitis with associated cervical lymphadenopathy and fever. Treatment includes Azithromycin (due to penicillin allergy) and supportive care with follow-up scheduled in 3 days.
subjective.symptoms: Sore throat | Fever | Headache | Odynophagia | Cervical lymph node tenderness | Mild runny nose
objective.physical_exam_findings: Erythematous throat | White patches on tonsils | Enlarged cervical lymph nodes
objective.vital_signs: Temperature: 38.5C, Blood pressure and pulse: Normal
plan.treatment_plan: Complete full course of antibiotics | Increase fluid intake | Rest
